Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649961. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649961', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
